source: USGS Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 Tier 1 Surface Temperature (Landsat 8/9), accessed via Microsoft Planetary Computer
qa_policy: Mask QA_PIXEL bits 0–5, medium/high cloud and cirrus confidence, ST_QA > 3 K, distance to cloud < 1 km; keep water unless separately masked by QA. Require >=3 valid acquisition dates per pixel.
spatial_aggregation: Block mean of pixelwise temporal medians, pixel-center inclusion; small blocks without centers remain missing. Not independent temperature sensors in every block.
limitations: Clear-sky satellite surface temperature, not pedestrian air temperature, heat index, or daily maximum.
30 m pixels are resampled from 100 m thermal information.
Only actual overpass times are represented; this is not a June–August peak-hour average.
Uneven valid observations and small-block sampling must be reviewed.
Summer 2025 temperature differs in vintage from 2022 NAIP and 2021 published canopy.
friction_note: Earlier two-factor scores retained; the current map uses the separate provisional_walking_friction_heat_0_100 field.
